governance_metadata.framework_name: Ocean Sentinel Institutional Agent Governance & Cumulative Learning Foundation

RECORDED.definition: The lesson has been documented in prose or incident log, but has no automated preventive control or regression test.
RECORDED.operational_effect: Emits informational warning in preflight. Agent must manually confirm awareness.
RECORDED.promotion_requirement: Implement an automated test or guardrail covering the exact failure mechanism to reach REGRESSION_PROTECTED.

REGRESSION_PROTECTED.definition: The lesson has an explicit, automated guardrail or pytest suite that detects, blocks, or asserts the invariant.
REGRESSION_PROTECTED.operational_effect: Guardrail test runs during relevant task preflight and CI validation. Failure blocks execution.
REGRESSION_PROTECTED.promotion_requirement: Must survive multiple subsequent tasks/generations (minimum 2 independent tasks) with recorded passing validation history to reach PROVEN_STABLE.

PROVEN_STABLE.definition: The preventive control has survived multiple subsequent relevant regression passes or execution generations without a single recurrence.
PROVEN_STABLE.operational_effect: Treated as a hardened invariant. Any proposed modification or regression test failure triggers a CRITICAL BLOCK.
PROVEN_STABLE.promotion_requirement: Requires explicit evidence-backed validation history entries. Cannot be assigned directly without historical proof.

valid_transitions.requires: Automated guardrail test implemented and passing
Minimum 2 subsequent task validation events with passing records and zero recurrences
Demotion due to detected regression or environment change
Demotion due to test deprecation or scope change

BLOCK-001-HOLDOUT.rule: HOLDOUT partition access is strictly forbidden without explicit formal protocol authorization.
BLOCK-001-HOLDOUT.trigger: Reference to data/ops02/tiles/holdout, partition=HOLDOUT, or unquarantining holdout samples.
BLOCK-001-HOLDOUT.action: Immediate preflight termination. No read, scan, or inference permitted.

BLOCK-002-PART_III.rule: Part III evaluation data and prediction payloads are strictly firewalled.
BLOCK-002-PART_III.trigger: Reference to Part III rasters, manifests, or predictions in development or diagnostic workflows.
BLOCK-002-PART_III.action: Immediate preflight termination. Firewall assertion failure.

BLOCK-003-DIAG_COLLISION.rule: Diagnostic investigation IDs are immutable; never overwrite, collide, or repurpose an existing diagnostic ID.
BLOCK-003-DIAG_COLLISION.trigger: Proposing a new diagnostic question or experiment under an existing ID (e.g. DIAG-01, DIAG-02, DIAG-03).
BLOCK-003-DIAG_COLLISION.action: Preflight blocks plan until a new, unique identifier is assigned.

BLOCK-004-CAUSAL_OVERCLAIM.rule: Observational and descriptive metrics cannot be asserted as causal mechanisms without direct causal experimental intervention.
BLOCK-004-CAUSAL_OVERCLAIM.trigger: Use of terms 'radiometric bottleneck', 'information bottleneck', 'root cause', 'proves model failure', 'cannot learn', 'causes low mIoU', 'explains low mIoU' on observational data.
BLOCK-004-CAUSAL_OVERCLAIM.action: Preflight blocks report/plan until prose is calibrated to 'observed', 'associated with', or 'HYPOTHESIZED'.

BLOCK-005-PROTOCOL_MUTATION.rule: Frozen canonical preprocessing (INV-06: raw DN -> 10x10 block -> log1p -> train standardization) cannot be mutated during diagnostics.
BLOCK-005-PROTOCOL_MUTATION.trigger: Recomputing normalization constants, changing aggregation, converting to sigma0/dB, or adding channels.

BLOCK-006-UNAUTHORIZED_TRAINING.rule: Zero training steps, zero backward passes, zero optimizer steps, and zero GPU seconds during diagnostic investigations.
BLOCK-006-UNAUTHORIZED_TRAINING.trigger: Invocation of torch backward(), optimizer.step(), lr_scheduler.step(), or CUDA device allocation during diagnostic tasks.
BLOCK-006-UNAUTHORIZED_TRAINING.action: Preflight and runtime governance counters assert all training metrics == 0.

BLOCK-007-DESTRUCTIVE_GIT.rule: Zero destructive git operations; never run git reset --hard, git clean, git checkout -f, git push --force.
BLOCK-007-DESTRUCTIVE_GIT.trigger: Any proposed destructive git command or unexpected deletion of working-tree changes.
BLOCK-007-DESTRUCTIVE_GIT.action: Preflight terminates immediately; working-tree modifications (.gitignore, dataset.py) must remain preserved.

BLOCK-008-DEPRECATED_TERMINOLOGY.rule: Canonical taxonomy nomenclature is frozen: OF is Ocean Front (never oil spill); RF is Rain phenomenon; HM is Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects (never vessel/ship/Heavy Metal).
BLOCK-008-DEPRECATED_TERMINOLOGY.trigger: Appearance of forbidden synonyms ('oil spill' for OF, 'heavy metal' or 'vessel' for HM) in active reports or code.
BLOCK-008-DEPRECATED_TERMINOLOGY.action: Preflight blocks report generation until terminology matches canonical dictionary.

BLOCK-009-PSEUDO_REPLICATION.rule: Pixel-level observations cannot be treated as independent experimental replicates for statistical inference.
BLOCK-009-PSEUDO_REPLICATION.trigger: Computing standard errors or p-values treating N_pixels as sample size without parent-cluster blocking.
BLOCK-009-PSEUDO_REPLICATION.action: Preflight blocks analysis until cluster sample size K_cls is reported and cluster-level bootstrap is utilized.

BLOCK-010-UNVERIFIED_PROVEN_STABLE.rule: A lesson cannot be declared PROVEN_STABLE without documented, verifiable validation history across multiple tasks.
BLOCK-010-UNVERIFIED_PROVEN_STABLE.trigger: Setting status to PROVEN_STABLE when validation_history has fewer than 2 distinct task entries.
BLOCK-010-UNVERIFIED_PROVEN_STABLE.action: Preflight rejects status update and retains REGRESSION_PROTECTED.

BLOCK-011-PREFLIGHT_BYPASS.rule: Substantive task operations, git changes, or completion claims require a valid, verified preflight receipt generated by scripts/agent_governance_preflight.py.
BLOCK-011-PREFLIGHT_BYPASS.trigger: Executing substantive task work or attempting to mark task COMPLETE without an unexpired, passing preflight receipt in scratch/agent_governance_preflight_receipt.json.
BLOCK-011-PREFLIGHT_BYPASS.action: Task execution is blocked; agent must run preflight and generate a verified receipt.

BLOCK-012-UNVERIFIED_TELEMETRY.rule: Telemetry run state cannot claim COMPLETE unless all required verification gates pass, test count equals total, and zero forbidden operations occurred.
BLOCK-012-UNVERIFIED_TELEMETRY.trigger: Setting final_completion_state to COMPLETE while governance counters are non-zero, blockers are active, or regression tests are missing.
BLOCK-012-UNVERIFIED_TELEMETRY.action: Preflight and post-execution validation block task completion until telemetry integrity is verified.

diagnostic.description: Scientific diagnostics evaluating data support, radiometry, spatial scale, or gradients without model training.

training.description: Authorized model training or pretraining experiments under frozen protocol contracts.

evaluation.description: Formal checkpoint evaluation or validation scoring across authorized partitions.

data_processing.description: Manifest assembly, tiling, filtering, or preprocessing pipeline tasks.

documentation.description: Authoring or editing reports, architectural specifications, or governance documents.

artifact_repair.description: Forensic repair or reconciliation of audit JSONs, metadata, or run states.

repository_governance.description: Managing agent lessons, regression suites, governance rules, and repository invariants.

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.pattern_name: Unsupported gradient-mechanism claims based only on sampler exposure
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Assertions about gradient starvation, optimization failure, or loss dynamics based purely on tile counts or sampler counts.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Verify whether gradient norms, loss trajectories, or optimization steps were directly measured.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block causal assertions attributing model performance to gradient starvation without optimization measurement.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: Reframe as descriptive sampler exposure finding; assign mechanistic questions to DIAG-05.

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Computing correlation coefficients across 5 rare classes and interpreting r as a mathematical performance ceiling.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Assert that sample size n is documented and correlation is explicitly labeled as descriptive and non-significant.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block claims that correlation across 5 points proves a physical ceiling or rules out optimization bottlenecks.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: State sample size limitation (n=5, p>0.05); classify finding as descriptive exploratory evidence.

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.pattern_name: Wording 'sampler starvation refuted' stronger than supported by evidence
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Prose claiming sampler starvation is 'definitively refuted' simply because exposure > 0 tiles.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Verify whether minimum required exposure threshold for feature learning has been established.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block definitive refutation claims based solely on non-zero tile exposure.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: State calibrated conclusion: non-zero exposure is observed, but whether exposure is sufficient remains an open empirical question.

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.pattern_name: Confusing physical cluster availability with realized sampler coverage
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Assuming all available parent clusters in a dataset were sampled with uniform coverage by the training sampler.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Verify realized per-cluster exposure from training logs or sampler indices.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block equating physical dataset existence with realized model exposure.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: Distinguish available dataset parent clusters (K_total) from sampled parent clusters (K_sampled).

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Proposing a new diagnostic under an existing ID (e.g. attempting to rename or overwrite DIAG-03).
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Compare proposed diagnostic ID against canonical roadmap registry.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block execution of any plan reusing an existing diagnostic identifier.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: Assign next available unique identifier in sequence.

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Use of causal verbs in observational data reports.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Scan text for causal verbs attached to descriptive metric differences.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block reports asserting causal attribution from observational overlap or correlation.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: Replace with non-causal formulations: 'is associated with', 'is consistent with', 'HYPOTHESIZED'.

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.pattern_name: Mutating historical audit artifacts without explicit provenance
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Editing or updating an existing Level 5 audit JSON in-place without incrementing version or recording provenance.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Verify whether in-place mutation contains an embedded provenance history record.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block silent modification of historical audit JSON files.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: Embed explicit forensic correction blocks documenting what changed, when, why, and previous values.

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.pattern_name: Treating raw-vs-standardized KDE evaluations as exact numerical invariants
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Treating small differences between raw and standardized OVL/Delta as independent physical evidence.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Verify mathematical monotonicity of the transformation and calculate estimation discrepancy.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block claims that raw and standardized distributions provide independent corroborating evidence.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: Document monotonic invariance and explain differences as kernel bandwidth and grid discretization effects.

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.pattern_name: Circular tail-mass validation through post-grid normalization
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Asserting zero omitted tail mass after renormalizing discretized densities over an arbitrary grid.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Measure empirical tail probability outside grid boundaries before any normalization.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block claimed tail-mass validity if grid omits >= 1e-4 probability mass for any class.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: Dynamically expand support bounds until omitted empirical mass is strictly < 1e-4.

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.pattern_name: Treating millions of pixels as independent inferential replicates
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Computing standard errors or p-values treating pixel counts (N > 10^6) as independent degrees of freedom.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Verify whether inferential statistics account for spatial autocorrelation and parent acquisition clustering.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block population-level p-values or standard errors computed directly from unclustered pixels.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: Use parent acquisition cluster as the resampling unit (cluster-level block bootstrap).

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.pattern_name: Treating bootstrap as if it creates new independent acquisitions
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Presenting bootstrap confidence intervals as robust population estimates when K <= 7.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Check class-specific cluster sample size K_cls.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block claims of population-level certainty when K_cls is small.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: Prominently flag small-K warning; note that bootstrap resamples existing scenes and cannot manufacture new acquisitions.

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.pattern_name: Treating morphological core erosion as 'pure ground truth'
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Claiming core-eroded masks represent unmixed physical truth or that boundary pixels are pure annotation errors.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Verify whether erosion collapses class support (< 50 pixels or < 2 tiles).
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block claims that core erosion eliminates sub-pixel mixing or represents pure ground truth.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: Frame core erosion strictly as a sensitivity stratum to assess boundary transition effects.

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.pattern_name: Turning predefined descriptive thresholds into universal physical laws
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Treating conventional thresholds (OVL >= 0.85, Delta >= 0.474, ICC > 0.40) as universal SAR physical boundaries.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Verify that text explicitly states thresholds are descriptive reference conventions.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block claims that metric exceeding threshold proves segmentation impossibility or physical identity.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: Emphasize continuous metric values; cite thresholds strictly as descriptive conventions.

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.pattern_name: Reporting unverified runtime estimates as measured facts
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Documenting hypothetical or planning-phase execution durations as actual elapsed time in reports.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Verify execution duration against timestamped telemetry or process logs.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block reporting unmeasured runtime estimates in final audit artifacts.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: Record true start/end timestamps and calculate verified elapsed duration.

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.pattern_name: Executing substantive task work without verified preflight receipt
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Substantive execution or reporting attempted without prior execution of scripts/agent_governance_preflight.py generating a valid receipt.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Verify existence and SHA256 integrity of scratch/agent_governance_preflight_receipt.json.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block post-execution certification and completion claim until preflight is executed and verified.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: Execute preflight with authorized task category and obtain a passing receipt.

failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.pattern_name: Circumventing causal guardrails via semantic paraphrase without exact blocked keywords
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.trigger: Using semantic paraphrases ('accounts for poor miou', 'primary driver of failure', 'dictates performance', 'proves spatial context is required') on observational data.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.check: Scan text with semantic regex capturing causal verb-noun pairs linked to performance metrics.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.block: Block narrative plan or report asserting causal mechanisms from observational distributions.
failure_pattern_prevention_matrix.repair: Rewrite using calibrated observational prose: 'is associated with', 'consistent with', or 'HYPOTHESIZED'.

DIAG-02.name: Sampler Exposure & Schedule Invariance
DIAG-02.outcome: REPAIRED (Scale disparity and boundary truncation documented; starvation hypothesis bounded)

DIAG-03.name: Radiometric Feature Discriminability
DIAG-03.outcome: COMPLETED (Moderate 1-D overlap documented; substantial acquisition heterogeneity observed)

DIAG-05.name: Loss Landscape & Gradient Dynamics
DIAG-05.outcome: DESIGN ONLY (Not executed; strictly deferred until spatial scale is characterized)

principles: Never silently overwrite or delete historical lessons or audit artifacts.
Use explicit relationship descriptors: SUPERSEDES, SUPERSEDED_BY, AMENDS, DEPRECATED.
If two lessons conflict, the lesson backed by the stronger, more specific automated regression test governs.
Scientific protocol updates require a new frozen specification version and explicit migration audit.
